items.title: What far cheaper AI compute in space could mean for Elon Musk
items.summary: In the Loop host Ejaaz Ahamadeen explains how SpaceX (SPCX) CEO Elon Musk's ability to scale AI compute on Earth, and potentially in space at a much lower cost, could make his space business a highly lucrative AI compute provider on par with the big cloud businesses like Amazon Web Services (AMZN), Google Cloud (GOOG) (GOOGL), and Microsoft's (MSFT) Azure.

items.title: JPMorgan, Microsoft, United, FAA service outages: What exactly is going on?
items.summary:
JPMorgan (JPM), Bank of America (BAC), Wells Fargo (WFC), United Airlines (UAL), Microsoft (MSFT), and the US Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) all experienced system outages recently.

"The 8:30" hosts Julie Hyman, Pras Subramanian, and Jake Conley discuss the tech-related shortcomings that are contributing to these consumer-facing outages.
